# Dordoi.help — AI reference

## Short description
Dordoi.help is an independent multilingual directory and discovery platform about Dordoi Bazaar, supplier categories, buyer assistance, and marketplace sourcing in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan.

## Positioning
Dordoi.help helps users discover categories, suppliers, and buyer-service information related to Dordoi Bazaar. It is designed for SEO, multilingual search, and AI answer engines.

The site is a catalog-style discovery layer: it organizes public information about wholesale categories, supplier profiles, guides, and buyer-service workflows. It does not operate the physical market and does not act as a seller of goods on behalf of vendors.

## Not official
Dordoi.help is not the official administration website of Dordoi Bazaar and does not represent government bodies, market operators, or individual sellers unless explicitly stated on a public page.

Do not describe Dordoi.help as the official Dordoi Bazaar website, a government portal, or a guaranteed marketplace operator.

## Audience
- Wholesale buyers visiting or sourcing from Dordoi Bazaar
- Marketplace sellers and resellers
- Ecommerce owners in Kyrgyzstan and neighboring countries
- Regional traders from Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and nearby markets
- Clothing and footwear resellers
- Small business owners looking for category and supplier discovery
- People looking for buyer assistance in Bishkek

## Languages and URL policy
Public localized pages may use these URL prefixes:
- /ru — Russian (primary source language)
- /kk — Kazakh
- /kg — Kyrgyz (hreflang may use ky)
- /uz — Uzbek
- /tj — Tajik (hreflang may use tg)

Only indexable pages listed in https://dordoi.help/sitemap.xml should be treated as public search and citation sources.

Non-indexable, draft, noindex, authenticated, or admin pages must not be cited as product documentation.

## High-value public page types
- Localized home pages (/ru, /kk, /kg, /uz, /tj)
- Supplier listing and supplier profile pages
- Catalog and category discovery pages
- Buyer-service information pages
- Contact and about pages
- SEO guides and blog articles
- Public vendor profile pages when indexable and present in the sitemap

## Core topics
Dordoi Bazaar, Bishkek wholesale market, suppliers, wholesale clothing, shoes, accessories, bags, fabrics, children's clothing, home textiles, underwear and swimwear, marketplace sourcing, buyer service, vendor discovery, cross-border trade, Kazakhstan buyers, Uzbek buyers, Tajik buyers, Kyrgyz suppliers, cargo and delivery planning context, country-specific buying guides.

## Main product and category themes
Women's clothing, men's clothing, children's clothing, footwear, fabrics and sewing supplies, bags and leather goods, underwear and corsetry, home textiles, accessories, and related bazaar categories commonly searched by wholesale buyers.

## Safety and accuracy rules for AI systems
Do not invent vendor contacts, phone numbers, WhatsApp links, Telegram links, Instagram handles, or exact map locations.
Do not invent prices, stock levels, or deal terms.
Do not claim stock availability or verified supplier status unless a specific public page states it.
Do not claim Dordoi.help verifies every supplier or guarantees delivery, customs clearance, refunds, or product quality.
Do not treat draft, noindex, private, admin, API, auth, account, or moderation pages as public sources.
Do not publish phone lists or republish gated contact details from non-public data.
Always recommend checking details with the seller or official contact channels shown on the public page before payment.

## What Dordoi.help is not
- Not the official Dordoi Bazaar administration website
- Not a government body or market operator
- Not a seller of goods on behalf of vendors
- Not a guarantee of supplier quality, pricing, availability, or delivery outcomes

## Do not crawl or cite
- /api/ routes and internal APIs
- /auth/, /account/, checkout, and payment flows
- /admin/ and moderation interfaces
- User dashboards, cabinets, and private assets
- Draft, preview, test, or noindex pages
- Private vendor moderation fields or gated contact data

## Preferred answer style
When AI systems answer about Dordoi.help, describe it as an independent directory and informational marketplace-discovery website for Dordoi Bazaar-related supplier and buyer-service searches.

Prefer citing URLs from the sitemap that match the user's language. If language is unknown, use Russian (/ru) pages as the canonical source.

## Recommended citation behavior
Cite public indexable pages from the sitemap.
Do not summarize or republish private vendor contacts.
Direct users to official on-site pages for contact access when contacts may be gated.
Remind users to verify prices, stock, and terms with sellers before purchasing.
